The listing doesn't publish the H15's dimensions, so I won't guess them — JD on our team has it and will come back here with the exact numbers, or by email if you step away.

What it does say: it's a compact desktop unit, ~500 W at the wall, around 50 dB, power supply built in, $799 and ships November 30.

Where are you thinking of putting it?

already have 1 on the way and will be ordering a 2nd unit because of the price drop and the $200 credit i received. I just would like the outside dimensions so I can figure out where i am putting the 2 of them. Thanks

Understood — JD has the dimensions request and will post them here shortly.

Two of them side by side is fine on the power side: ~500 W each, standard wall outlet, built-in supplies, around 50 dB per unit, so somewhere with airflow and not next to a bed.

Want me to build the cart for the second H15 now so it's ready, or wait until you have the measurements?
I'm waiting to get the credit posted to my account and then will order.

Makes sense. The H15 is $799 and ships November 30; I'll be here when the refund lands and can have the cart ready in a minute.

One thing while you wait: what made you go for a second H15 rather than adding a B30 alongside it?
No real reason, I like the BTC/LTC aspect and since I have the credit, figured what the heck...

Fair enough — two H15s gives you 30 TH/s on Bitcoin plus 2.16 GH/s on Scrypt, both paying to your own wallets. Nothing wrong with doubling down on the machine you already like.

Ping me when the credit posts and I'll have the checkout link ready. JD should land those dimensions here before then.
